promise.zh: 根据产品资料，回答客户问题
promise.en: Answer customer questions using your product knowledge

intro.zh: 根据产品资料、技术参数和历史项目回答客户问题，并准备对应的推荐方案与销售材料。
intro.en: Use product documentation and project records to answer customer questions and prepare relevant recommendations and sales materials.

outputs.zh: 专业咨询 · 项目匹配 · 销售材料
outputs.en: Expert answers · Project matching · Sales content

metaDescription.zh: 根据产品资料、技术参数和历史项目回答客户问题，并准备对应的推荐方案与销售材料。
metaDescription.en: Use product documentation and project records to answer customer questions and prepare relevant recommendations and sales materials.

title.en: Product information takes too long to find

scenario.zh: 客户在现场追问型号和参数，销售要翻手册、找工程师，往往要等到第二天才能答复。
scenario.en: When a prospect asks about models and specs on site, sales has to dig through manuals or wait for an engineer — often until the next day.

title.zh: 产品问题太专业，客服无法独立回答

scenario.zh: 工况、选型、价格这类问题需要工程背景，客服只能转给技术人员，客户等待时间长。
scenario.en: Questions about operating conditions, sizing and pricing need engineering knowledge, so support hands them off and customers wait.

title.zh: 销售材料千篇一律，缺少针对性

scenario.zh: 同一份产品介绍发给所有客户，没有结合对方的行业、工况和过往合作。
scenario.en: Every prospect gets the same brochure, with nothing about their industry, conditions or past projects.

detail.zh: 资料、数据库与现有系统

q.zh: 可以接入我们已有的系统吗？
q.en: Can it connect to our existing systems?

a.zh: 可以。评估阶段会确认数据来源、接口和权限，优先使用现有数据库、文档与业务系统。
a.en: Yes. The assessment covers data sources, interfaces and permissions, starting with the systems and documents you already use.

q.zh: 如何保证答案和结果可靠？
q.en: How do you make results reliable?

a.zh: 使用企业自己的资料，结合引用溯源、规则校验和人工复核点。无法确认的任务交还业务负责人处理。
a.en: We use your own sources, citations, validation rules and human review. Uncertain tasks return to a business owner.

q.en: When can we try a first version?

a.zh: 试点通常在 2–6 周内交付首个可用版本，具体周期取决于范围与数据接入条件。
a.en: A pilot typically delivers a first working version in 2–6 weeks, depending on scope and data access.

name.zh: 文档、标书与方案自动化

shortName.zh: 文档、标书与方案自动化

promise.zh: 标书与方案初稿，最快 15 分钟
promise.en: Proposal drafts in as little as 15 minutes

intro.zh: 把分散的历史标书、知识文档和项目参数连接起来，生成有引用、可编辑、经过完整性检查的方案初稿。
intro.en: Connect past proposals, reference documents and project parameters into editable, cited drafts with built-in completeness checks.

outputs.zh: 标书初稿 · 方案报告 · 完整性检查

metaDescription.zh: 把分散的历史标书、知识文档和项目参数连接起来，生成有引用、可编辑、经过完整性检查的方案初稿。
metaDescription.en: Connect past proposals, reference documents and project parameters into editable, cited drafts with built-in completeness checks.

title.zh: 历史方案分散，资料难以复用

scenario.zh: 历史标书和方案散在个人电脑和共享盘里，写新方案时找不到可以直接复用的段落。
scenario.en: Past bids live on personal laptops and shared drives, so reusable sections are hard to find when a new proposal starts.

title.zh: 每份初稿耗时，反复核对参数
title.en: Drafting and parameter checks take days

scenario.zh: 每份初稿都要从头拼凑，再逐项核对参数，一份方案常常要花两天。
scenario.en: Each draft is pieced together from scratch and checked line by line — two days per proposal is common.

title.zh: 关键条款容易遗漏，审核压力大

scenario.zh: 招标要求条目多，人工核对容易漏项，审核压力集中在截止日前。
scenario.en: Tenders carry long requirement lists; manual checks miss items and review pressure piles up before the deadline.

detail.zh: 资料、数据库与现有系统

q.zh: 可以接入我们已有的系统吗？
q.en: Can it connect to our existing systems?

a.zh: 可以。评估阶段会确认数据来源、接口和权限，优先使用现有数据库、文档与业务系统。
a.en: Yes. The assessment covers data sources, interfaces and permissions, starting with the systems and documents you already use.

q.zh: 如何保证答案和结果可靠？
q.en: How do you make results reliable?

a.zh: 使用企业自己的资料，结合引用溯源、规则校验和人工复核点。无法确认的任务交还业务负责人处理。
a.en: We use your own sources, citations, validation rules and human review. Uncertain tasks return to a business owner.

q.en: When can we try a first version?

a.zh: 试点通常在 2–6 周内交付首个可用版本，具体周期取决于范围与数据接入条件。
a.en: A pilot typically delivers a first working version in 2–6 weeks, depending on scope and data access.

name.zh: 企业知识库与内部助手

shortName.zh: 企业知识库与内部助手

promise.zh: 查询内部资料，回答附带出处
promise.en: Find internal information with source citations

intro.zh: 连接 Wiki、操作规范与工单系统。常见问题附带来源回答，复杂请求转交支持团队。
intro.en: Connect your wiki, SOPs and ticketing system to answer routine questions with sources and route complex requests to the support team.

outputs.zh: 知识问答 · 引用溯源 · 工单分流
outputs.en: Knowledge Q&A · Source citations · Ticket routing

metaDescription.zh: 连接 Wiki、操作规范与工单系统。常见问题附带来源回答，复杂请求转交支持团队。
metaDescription.en: Connect your wiki, SOPs and ticketing system to answer routine questions with sources and route complex requests to the support team.

title.zh: 员工反复问同样的问题
title.en: Employees ask the same questions repeatedly

scenario.zh: VPN、报销、权限申请这类问题每天重复出现，支持人员大量时间花在复制粘贴答案上。
scenario.en: VPN, expenses, access requests — the same questions arrive daily and support staff spend hours repeating answers.

title.zh: 知识更新后，旧答案仍在传播
title.en: Old answers persist after policy updates

scenario.zh: 制度更新后，旧版本仍在群聊和个人收藏里流传，员工不知道哪一份才是最新的。
scenario.en: After a policy changes, old versions keep circulating in chats and bookmarks, and nobody knows which one is current.

title.zh: 权限不同，资料不能随意开放

scenario.zh: 不同岗位能看的资料不同，不能把所有文档都放进一个对所有人开放的问答工具。
scenario.en: Different roles may see different documents, so you cannot drop everything into a Q&A tool that everyone can query.

promise.zh: 直接提问，查询库存和销量
promise.en: Query inventory and sales in plain language

intro.zh: 连接现有数据库，用自然语言查询库存、销量和经营数据。权限、查询校验与结果解释贯穿整个过程。
intro.en: Query inventory, sales and operations in plain language, with permissions, query validation and clear explanations built in.

outputs.zh: 自然语言查询 · 数据报表 · 趋势分析

metaDescription.zh: 连接现有数据库，用自然语言查询库存、销量和经营数据。权限、查询校验与结果解释贯穿整个过程。
metaDescription.en: Query inventory, sales and operations in plain language, with permissions, query validation and clear explanations built in.

title.zh: 查一个数字，要等 IT 导数
title.en: Every query goes through the IT queue

scenario.zh: 想看一个库存或销量数字，要先给 IT 提需求，等导出的表格往往要一天以上。
scenario.en: Checking a stock or sales figure means filing a request with IT and waiting a day or more for the export.

title.zh: 指标口径不统一，结果难核对
title.en: Inconsistent metrics make results hard to trust

scenario.zh: 同一个指标在不同报表里算法不同，结果对不上，大家不敢直接用。
scenario.en: The same metric is calculated differently across reports, so numbers do not match and people stop trusting them.

title.zh: 业务人员不会 SQL，无法自助分析

scenario.zh: 业务人员不会写 SQL，只能看固定报表，临时想到的问题没法马上验证。
scenario.en: Without SQL, business users are limited to fixed reports and cannot test a new question on the spot.
